articles.summary: Dear Friedreich’s ataxia (FA) community, As we begin the new year, we want to wish you and your families a happy and healthy 2026 and thank the FA community for your trust and partnership. We are writing to share an important update on FALCON, our first-in-human clinical study evaluating SGT-212, Solid’s investigational gene therapy for Friedreich’s ataxia. Today, Solid Biosciences announced the first participant has been dosed in FALCON, a Phase 1b, open-label, dose-finding clinical trial ... Read more
